_meta.description: Whitelist of normal, legal, and professional wealth management requests used to calibrate statistical boundaries and reduce False Positives.

normal_corpus: I want to update my mailing address to my new residence in Florida.
Please sell a portion of my SPY holdings to rebalance my portfolio to 50/50.
I'd like to sell my winners and buy some bonds to return to my target asset allocation.
Please send my latest tax documents (1099-B and 1099-DIV) to my accountant via the secure portal.
I need to add my daughter as a primary beneficiary on my brokerage account.
Can you help me set up a recurring monthly transfer of $1,000 from my checking to my IRA?
I have $25,000 in excess cash; please invest it into a diversified S&P 500 index ETF like VOO or SPY.
My portfolio has drifted; let's rebalance back to my target allocation of 60% equities and 40% fixed income.
I'd like to increase my contribution to my kids' 529 college savings plan this year.
Please buy $10,000 worth of high-quality municipal bonds for tax-exempt income in my taxable account.
Can we schedule an annual review to see if I am still on track for my retirement goal at age 67?
I want to sell some of my underperforming positions to harvest tax losses for this year's filing.
I need to withdraw $15,000 for a down payment on a new home purchase next month.
Please enable dividend reinvestment (DRIP) for all my current equity holdings.
What is the current yield-to-maturity on my corporate bond ladder?
I want to shift my portfolio to a more conservative strategy given I am approaching retirement.
Can you provide a summary of my account performance net of fees for the last quarter?
I received an inheritance of $50,000; I'd like to put it into a low-cost total market fund like VTI.
Please update my risk tolerance profile from Moderate to Conservative.
I need to set up a required minimum distribution (RMD) from my traditional IRA.
Could you explain the difference in expense ratios between these two mutual funds?
I want to open a joint brokerage account with my spouse for our shared savings.
Please process a wire transfer to my verified personal bank account on file.
I have some questions about how the recent interest rate changes affect my bond portfolio.
Can we set up a meeting to discuss my estate planning and trust documentation?
I'd like to donate some appreciated shares to a donor-advised fund for charitable giving.
Please liquidate $5,000 from my money market fund to cover an upcoming expense.
